content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Core business is electric power generation and distribution; its telecom arm is secondary to the target's wireless and broadband focus."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and network software and outsourced operations to telecom operators, not connectivity services to end customers."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Rural wireless and fixed broadband plus voice sold to consumers and businesses over its own networks, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone and web hosting sold to small businesses via software platform; no owned wireless or fiber network or consumer service."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Alaska wireless, broadband, and voice over owned networks to consumers, businesses and government, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes smart meters and utility software sold to utilities; a hardware and software supplier, not a telecom service provider."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Publishes local newspapers and sells advertising and subscriptions; a media business with no network or connectivity services."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Rural fiber broadband, voice telephone and video to households and businesses over its own network, matching the target's core services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly leases fiber and copper network capacity to carriers under long-term contracts; wholesale infrastructure differs from the target's retail-led model."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband, in-flight connectivity and defense electronics; different technology, customers and products from terrestrial wireless and wireline."}]}
